summary: GKE disables new beta APIs by default in new clusters and allows them to be enabled on creation or later in GKE 1.27 and higher.
extended_definition: GKE disables new beta APIs by default in new clusters and allows them to be enabled on creation or later in GKE 1.27 and higher.
